title: Force RF Band Info
description: Forces RadioServingSystemAO's serving RF band/channel/bandwidth world state, re-publishing mp/ind/radio/rf_band_info. Every field is optional and applied only if present. Backs IServingSystemListener::onRFBandInfoChanged testing. Distinct from set_rf_band_preferences (device capability preference, an AP RPC): this forces the currently *active* band, not the preference list.

slot.description: Which SIM slot's RF band info to force.
